737:t_009:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「Here we come, $$御使い$$s! We'll end the universe's history of war right here!」

737:t_009:36.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahaha, come on! I'll play with you a little!」

737:t_009:37.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「This $$プロディキウム$$ was meant to serve as the vessel for the Supreme God's rebirth! It is the crystallization of our wisdom!」

737:t_009:38.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So it's the seat of God...! That suits us perfectly too!」

737:t_009:40.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And I'll put an end... to your plans!」

737:t_009:41.en:
$n
「We won't hand them over! Our lives, our $$スフィア$$s... or our future!」

737:t_009:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$! You are the source of the universe's distortions, and we will surpass you here!」

737:t_009:43.en:
$n
「I'll show you! This is the human $$シンカ$$ you feared!!」

737:t_010:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「This isn't right, $$ドクトリン$$! $$プロディキウム$$ can't be losing!」

737:t_010:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「If we lose here, the means to stop the universe's great collapse will...!」

737:t_010:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You don't need to worry about that!」

737:t_010:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You don't need to worry about that!」

737:t_010:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You don't need to worry about that!」

737:t_010:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Are you saying you don't care if the universe is destroyed!?」

737:t_010:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't you understand yet!? The ones bringing about the universe's great collapse... the true $$バアル$$...」

737:t_010:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of all the things you could say...!」

737:t_010:12.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You dare call us $$バアル$$!? Know your place, you fools!」

737:t_010:13.en:
$$レド$$
「You don't seem to understand anything about yourselves!」

737:t_010:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The $$バアル$$... the apostles of the force that seeks to vanish try to erase the force that seeks to exist.」

737:t_010:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's exactly what you do, taking lives for your own selfish reasons!」

737:t_010:17.en:
$$葵$$
「As you take lives, the force that seeks to vanish keeps growing stronger!」

737:t_010:18.en:
$$万丈$$
「We've defeated the $$宇宙怪獣$$! Now, if you disappear, the universe's great collapse will stop!」

737:t_010:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Th-that's a lie, right...? $$テンプティ$$ and the others can't be... the power causing the universe's great collapse...」

737:t_010:20.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「I refuse to accept it! I will not accept this prattle from mere humans!」

737:t_010:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「You look down on us like that, so you can casually take lives and destroy galaxies!」

737:t_010:22.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Enough already! You're the worst villains in this whole universe!」

737:t_010:23.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Wh-what are we going to do, $$ドクトリン$$!?」

737:t_010:24.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s! We alone are the absolute beings who can save the universe!」

737:t_010:25.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We cannot let the $$バアル$$ threaten our existence! We will retreat with the $$黒い太陽#sol$$!」

737:t_010:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah, I know! That must be the $$超特異点$$!」

737:t_010:29.en:
$n
「That's the key to repairing all of spacetime thrown into chaos by the $$大時空震動$$...!?」

737:t_010:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$時空震動弾$$ created by $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$ in a certain world...」

737:t_010:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whether by accident or design, I cannot say, but it must have briefly touched this $$エス・テラン$$ at the instant of its activation.」

737:t_010:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「All parallel worlds were caught up in it because this universe, which touches them all, shook for an instant...」

737:t_010:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was the power of something at the very heart of $$エス・テラン$$, the foundation of this world...」

737:t_010:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ヴィルダーク$$ knew that...! So he wanted the Singularities' power to investigate $$エス・テラン$$!」

737:t_011:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$黒い太陽#sol$$ is the source of our power! We cannot surrender it!」

737:t_020:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「What are you going to do, $$ゼロ$$!?」

737:t_020:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Are you saying mere humans have some way to defeat us!?」

737:t_020:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ told me your weakness!」

737:t_020:6.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$ commands you! $$怒りのドクトリン$$, $$楽しみのテンプティ$$! Obey my orders!」

737:t_021:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Has he... lived for this very moment...?」

737:t_021:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
(He's risking his life to defy the gods...)

737:t_022:0.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Damn...! I was just one step away!」

737:t_022:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But I cannot allow you to slay them.」

737:t_022:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No! You weren't supposed to be able to come back...!」

737:t_022:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, $$ドクトリン$$, $$テンプティ$$... Go to the $$黒い太陽#sol$$.」

737:t_012:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Well done returning, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Now... let us destroy them and stop the universe's great collapse!」

737:t_012:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That isn't what I mean, $$ドクトリン$$.」

737:t_013:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard! He swallowed $$ドクトリン$$ and $$テンプティ$$!」

737:t_013:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Now all four $$御使い$$s have become one...!」

737:t_013:4.en:
???
「Yes... The $$御使い$$s no longer exist in this world.」

737:t_013:5.en:
???
「No... humanity, the $$バアル$$, everything will first return to nothing, and I will be the only being left in this world.」

737:t_013:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Now, come to me! $$ヘリオース$$, $$プロディキウム$$!」
